crossRefs.note: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him, then he vanished out of their sight.
When they came down to him, Elisha prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please strike this people with blindness.” He struck…
After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.
But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

translations.web: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

translations.kjv: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
